title: UP Family ID Ek Parivar Ek Pahchan Scheme Online Registration 2023
postName: Ek Parivar Ek Pahchan – Family ID Registration
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP Family ID / Ek Parivar Ek Pahchan portal
2. Register head of family with Aadhaar and mobile
3. Add family members details
4. Verify OTP and submit
5. Download Family ID card / number for welfare schemes
shortDescription: UP Family ID (Ek Parivar Ek Pahchan) Online Registration – one unique family ID for government schemes in Uttar Pradesh.
content:
Ek Parivar Ek Pahchan is Uttar Pradesh’s initiative to create a unique Family ID for each household to deliver welfare schemes transparently.

Families register online with Aadhaar-linked details of members. Family ID helps in ration, scholarships and other state benefits.
